title: Grilled Cod with Roasted Vegetables
description: Simply grilled cod fillets with lemon alongside roasted zucchini and asparagus.
steps: Toss the zucchini and asparagus with oil and roast at 200C for 15 minutes.
Season the cod and grill or pan-sear 3-4 minutes per side.
Serve the fish over the roasted vegetables with a squeeze of lemon.
notes: A genuinely simple, low-effort dinner — good for nights you want something light but still filling.
